# The 90s Club

The 90s Club is a Kerala kitchen and rooftop taproom in Electronic City, Bangalore. The taproom serves Flying Fox craft beer.

Address: Millennium Plaza, 396/48 Hosur Rd, Hebbagodi, Electronic City 560100
Phone: +91 96321 48811
Hours: 12pm–12am daily
